subject: Throughput variance & account make-good discussion
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan@helios.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-02 09:12 -0700
Subject: Production throughput drop + 5xx spike — immediate attention needed

Diego,

We saw a significant throughput regression across our primary production routes yesterday morning (Oct 1 ~03:40–09:10 UTC). Error rate jumped to ~8% 5xx and tail latency doubled. This materially impacted our ingestion pipeline and delayed downstream billing jobs.

We need:
- A timeline of the incident and root cause within 48 hours
- An initial estimate of commercial compensation (credits) for the impacted window
- Exec-level engagement — our Head of Ops is prepping an internal postmortem and will escalate if we don’t get a clear remediation path.

I’ve attached basic logs and a short summary. Procurement may also want a formal amendment/statement of work if this recurs.

Thanks,
Evan
Head of SRE, Helios Labs

Attachment: initial-incident-log.txt
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan@helios.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-02 09:35 -0700
Subject: Re: Production throughput drop + 5xx spike — immediate attention needed

Evan —

Thanks for flagging and for the logs. I’m very sorry for the impact here. I’ve looped in Monica (CS lead) and Vivek (engineering) for an immediate technical triage and Laura for commercial coordination.

Immediate actions we are taking:
- Engineering is collecting full trace spans, autoscaler metrics, and kernel logs now.
- We will prioritize Helios’ routes for the next 12 hours and apply a temporary capacity bump to stabilize throughput.
- Monica will produce an initial usage/impact worksheet and a provisional credit calc within 24 hours.

Can we schedule an exec call tomorrow morning (Oct 3) to walk through the RCA and commercial proposal? Please propose a 60-minute window. If Procurement needs docs, include them on the thread.

I will follow up with a short remediation timeline and a preliminary credit estimate by EOD Oct 3.

— Diego
Director, Customer Success 
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Evan Brooks <evan@helios.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-02 11:08 -0700
Subject: Re: Production throughput drop + 5xx spike — immediate attention needed

Quick update — doing the impact math and attaching a usage breakdown (by route, by hour). Preliminary observations:
- Impact window observed 2028-10-01 03:37–09:12 UTC (~5h35m of elevated errors/latency).
- Request volume during the window: 125M tokens (Helios account).
- 5xx rate peak: 8.2% for the primary generation endpoint.

Provisional commercial approach (suggested, subject to leadership):
- Credit equals the fraction of affected requests multiplied by that day’s billable token charge, plus a 10% goodwill uplift for operational disruption.
- For sustained performance degradation beyond thresholds, propose a capped payout equal to one month’s average spend.

Attachment: usage-breakdown.csv; credit-calculation.xlsx

I’ll sync with engineering on RCA details; will deliver a working credit figure by Oct 3 EOD.

— Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Evan Brooks <evan@helios.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-03 08:50 -0700
Subject: Re: Production throughput drop + 5xx spike — immediate attention needed

Evan / team —

Preliminary engineering RCA:
- Root cause: autoscaler mis-provisioned a fraction of Helios’ pod fleet during a brief kernel OOM spike. The runtime experienced degraded KV cache refresh rates, compounding token-generation latency under burst traffic.
- Mitigation applied: forced warm-provisioning and temporary dedicated slots for Helios routes (applied 2028-10-02 02:15 UTC).
- Long-term fix: patch to autoscaler backoff logic + kernel-level memory handling update to land in the next runtime release (v1.18.3).

Commercial note from ops: we accept that the outage window is material. Proposed credit formula (engineering + CS combined):
- Base credit = (impacted token fraction) * (daily token cost)
- Operational uplift = 12% of base credit for multi-route impact and downstream process delays
- Cap = one calendar month average spend for Helios (to avoid runaway exposure)

Attaching a short RCA summary. Happy to review this on the exec call and tighten the numbers with Monica/Laura.

Attachment: incident-rca.pdf

— Vivek
VP, Engineering — Serving Runtime, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan@helios.ai>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-03 13:20 -0700
Subject: Re: Production throughput drop + 5xx spike — immediate attention needed

Evan —

Thanks for your patience while we assembled the details. Based on Monica’s usage sheet and Vivek’s RCA, here is a commercial proposal to resolve the account impact quickly:

Proposal (for Helios Labs):
- One-time credit equal to the calculated base credit + 12% uplift (as outlined by engineering). Monica’s workbook shows a preliminary credit of $48,200 for the impacted window.
- Cap remains one month’s average spend (Helios average: $172,000/mo).
- As a remediation guarantee, offer a 30-day discounted dedicated capacity pilot (20% discount) while we fully roll the autoscaler fix — helps prevent recurrence during the patching window.
- Require a simple amendment to the Master Services Agreement to record the credit and pilot terms (we will draft and DocuSign).

Next steps we propose:
1) Exec call 2028-10-04 10:00 PT to review RCA, credit calc, and amendment language.
2) If Helios approves, we will issue the credit in the next billing cycle and send the amendment for signature.

If procurement wants a different commercial structure (invoice offset vs. direct credit), we can accommodate — please loop them in.

— Laura
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Evan Brooks <evan@helios.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Helios Procurement <procurement@helios.ai>
Date: 2028-10-04 17:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Production throughput drop + 5xx spike — immediate attention needed

Laura / Diego —

Thanks for the quick, thorough response and the proposed numbers. We’re aligned to join the exec call on Oct 4 10:00 PT. A few quick asks ahead of the call:
- Please circulate the credit-calculation.xlsx with the line-by-line math and assumptions (Monica — I’ll need one consolidated sheet for procurement).
- We’ll want the amendment draft in DocuSign format before signature — procurement will review legal language.
- Please confirm whether the dedicated-capacity pilot requires a separate PO or can be handled under the existing contract.

I’ll have procurement on the call; they’ll push back on anything that creates retroactive obligations without an offset.

See you tomorrow.

— Evan
Head of SRE, Helios Labs

Attachment: procurement-introduction.pdf (forwarded)
